svg.text: APR3 - Mixed gapped routes and 3D routes in a line, with
multiple log fields, multiple location fields and 1 referent
Log: point events, 2 intersections, and spanning and non
spanning line events. Mix prefix/suffix configuration. Use
filter expression on a point event “Num >= 2” and a spanning
line event “Type is not Class3”. Merge coincident events for
Polygon layers have overlapping and gapped polygons
Referent: nearest; without prefix/suffix, in miles
Some point events cannot be drawn; 1 spanning line event can be
partially drawn; 1 spanning line event cannot be drawn at all
No End City1 Limit for the first City1
If there is no referent on the route (not
Coincident events only have 1 start and 1 end
For overlapping polygons, City Column says the
last city the route enters, but either is fine
If an event can be partially drawn, the route
start/end counts for the event’s start/end
When a route is not calibrated and there are
events with loc error on it, just return 1 row
